summary: Full regression + new Multimodal feature testing. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (9 existing + 4 new tests for /api/multimodal/plan). Frontend: 12/12 critical flows pass including multimodal panel (4 cards rendered, ★ on best, emerald border), measure tool (cyan dashed line + markers), sector switch Madrid↔Barcelona, parking/bicis/heatmap toggles, all 3 map styles (normal/satellite/3D), refresh, event queue click → event-detail, geocoder, map zoom-in/out (no marker drift), click on multimodal option draws polyline + emits [MMOD] Selected log.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1390 lines — strongly recommend splitting into modules: /app/backend/routers/{events,parking,geocode,uber,multimodal}.py. File is now well past the 700-line soft limit.
_azure_route_simple silently returns None on any exception — caller has no visibility into Azure failures. Consider structured logging at WARNING level when Azure routing fails for diagnostics.
Multimodal endpoint makes up to 3 sequential Azure route calls per request (car-direct, car-to-parking, parking-walk). These could be parallelized via asyncio.gather to halve latency (~2.5s → ~1s).
Frontend CommandCenter.jsx is large (>1100 lines). Consider extracting measure tool, multimodal handlers, and event-marker layer setup into dedicated hooks (useMeasureTool, useEventMarkersLayer).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multimodal endpoint /api/multimodal/plan returns 4 options for Madrid coords (40.50,-3.80 → 40.4168,-3.7038): COCHE DIRECTO (37.1min, best=true), COCHE+PARKING+TRANSPORTE (37.7min), COCHE+PARKING+ANDAR (39.2min), 100% TRANSPORTE PÚBLICO (51.9min). 3 parkings considered (Carmen, Plaza de Oriente, El Corte Inglés). Frontend RoutePanel renders cards with data-testid='multimodal-opt-{0..3}'. Best option has class 'border-emerald-400/60' + ★ prefix. Clicking a card calls onPickMultimodal which draws a dashed LineString on map in option.color and pushes [MMOD] Selected log to diagnostic stream. Measure tool: 'SEG XXm · TOTAL X.XXXkm' header text only shows on mousemove hover (cursorMeasure state), not after raw clicks — this is by design. Tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_multimodal.py.
rca of the issue: No issues found. New multimodal feature works end-to-end (backend Azure routing + parking POI fuzzy search + frontend cards + map polyline). Existing functionality (events, parking, geocode, measure, map styles, sector switch) preserved. Azure POI fuzzy=parking change (from category 7311) successfully returns 3+ parkings for Madrid center.
